reply_text:
I saved Hollis's correction to the workspace brain: Marrow Fieldworks' 2026 renewal is for 87 seats, not 268. The new entry says it replaces this morning's figure and points back to his original message.

The old 268 entry couldn't be removed and is still live. When I tried to expire it, the brain said the entry didn't exist, and it failed again when I retried, even though it still comes up when I look it up. For now both figures are stored, and the 87 one is clearly marked as the correction. Someone with direct access to the brain will need to delete the 268 entry by hand, or anyone looking up Marrow Fieldworks could pick up the wrong number.

I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message and told him about the leftover entry.
